title: asyneuma cichoriiforme

It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
